To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of compost and mineral fertilizer combination can significantly improve yield and quality of tomatoes and sustain soil fertility status.
the combined use of plant residue compost with mineral fertilizers significantly increased yield and quality of tomatoes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a field trial to evaluate the effect of different compost and mineral fertilizer treatments on tomato yield and quality, soil fertility and sustainability in a long-term field experiment.
the effect of compost and inorganics fertilizer on yield, quality of fruit and soil fertility status of tomato grown on silt loamy soil of Peshawar.
the effect of organic and inorganic fertilization on the growth and yield of tomato (Lycopersicon esculentum Mill.).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

application of 180 kg N ha 1, 100 kg P ha 1 and 60 kg K ha 1 with 10 tons of compost ha 1 would be optimum dose to obtain maximum yield and quality of fruit and sustained soil organic matter and nutrient status.
application of compost along with full doses of N, P & K improved the yield and quality of the tomato fruit and sustained fertility status of the soil.
the combination of compost and in organic fertilizers significantly improved tomato yield and quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
compost and mineral fertilization are complementary to each other and should be applied together to achieve optimum yield and quality of crops.
the combination of plant residue (compost) and inorganic fertiliser (NPK) significantly improved the yield and quality of tomatoes.
the combination of plant residue and mineral fertilizers is the best option for sustainable agriculture and food production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compost can be used as a substitute for chemical fertilizers in tomato production.
compost and mineral fertilization is an efficient strategy to improve tomato production and soil fertility.
compost and inorganic fertilizer combination can significantly improve the yield and quality of tomatoes.
